_source_of_truth: This file is the single machine-readable source for every encoding table in docs/SPEC.md. The Markdown tables are GENERATED from it by spec/gen_spec.py; do not edit them in the document. spec/conformance.py checks this file field-by-field against the authoritative Python models in isa_bench/, and `make spec-check` fails if either the document or the models drift from it.
_authority: Where the Python models in isa_bench/ and the structural RTL in rtl/ disagree, the Python models win: they are the versions that pass the benchmarks. As of the freeze they agree on every shared constant (verified by conformance.py).

fields.name: test
fields.description: Test code selecting the condition evaluated on entry to the row.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Branch mode: how the true and false exits are derived from the target field.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Branch target row index, or 255 meaning return to the link register.

fields.name: pin_slot
fields.description: Which output slot the pin operation applies to; 3 selects the D+/D- pair.

fields.name: pin_op
fields.description: Pin operation applied to the selected slot.

tests.name: fifo
tests.description: True when the TX FIFO is not empty.

tests.name: srbit
tests.description: True when the shift register serial bit reads 1.

tests.name: tmr
tests.description: True on the cycle the timer reaches zero (the tick).

branch_modes.name: WAIT
branch_modes.description: Stay on this row until the test passes, then go to target.

branch_modes.name: BRANCH
branch_modes.description: Take the target when the test passes, otherwise fall through.

branch_modes.name: SKIP
branch_modes.description: Fall through when the test passes, otherwise take the target.

branch_modes.name: STEP
branch_modes.description: Fall through when the test passes, otherwise stay. The target field is unused.

pin_slots.name: pair
pin_slots.description: The D+/D- pair: writes slots 0 and 1 together.

pin_ops.name: hold
pin_ops.single: No write. The slot keeps its value.

pin_ops.name: sr
pin_ops.single: Drive the shift register serial bit.

pin_ops.name: d0
pin_ops.single: UNSPECIFIED for a single slot (see SPEC section 16).

pin_ops.name: d1
pin_ops.single: UNSPECIFIED for a single slot (see SPEC section 16).

action_groups.name: sr
action_groups.description: Shift register. At most one choice per row.

choices.description: No shift-register action.
Load a byte popped from the TX FIFO.
Load the configured constant K.
Load the complement of the CRC register, 5 bits.
Clear to zero.
Shift one place in the configured direction, inserting the fill bit.
Clear then shift.
Push the shift register to the RX FIFO.

action_groups.name: c1
action_groups.description: Counter 1. At most one choice per row.

choices.description: No counter 1 action.
Load counter 1 from configured value A.
Load counter 1 from configured value B.
Load counter 1 from configured value C.
Decrement counter 1, wrapping modulo 256.

action_groups.name: c2
action_groups.description: Counter 2. At most one choice per row.

choices.description: No counter 2 action.
Load counter 2 from its configured value.
Decrement counter 2, wrapping modulo 256.

action_groups.name: tm
action_groups.description: Timer reload override. At most one choice per row.

choices.description: No timer action; the timer free-runs.
Reload the timer with P-1 (a full bit period).
Reload the timer with P/2-1 (half a bit period).

action_groups.name: xx
action_groups.description: CRC and call. At most one choice per row.

choices.description: No action.
Reset the CRC register to all ones.
Advance the CRC by the shift register serial bit.
Write the row's false exit into the link register.
Reset the CRC and link, in that order.

state.name: link
state.description: Link register, written by the call action, read by target 255.

state.name: tcount
state.description: Timer down-counter. Width is not fixed by the models; see SPEC section 16.

state.name: pinv
state.description: Output slot values, one bit per slot.

config.name: P
config.description: Timer reload period, in core clock cycles.

config.name: shift
config.description: Shift direction, left or right. Selects which end of the shift register is the serial bit.

config.name: fill
config.description: Fill bit source for shift: constant 0, constant 1, or synchronized input 0.

config.name: loadk
config.description: The constant K loaded by loadk.

config.name: init_pins
config.description: Reset value of each output slot.

config.name: slot_modes
config.description: Per slot: push-pull or open-drain. In open-drain a 1 releases the net and a 0 drives it low.
